simple.summary: צִפְיוֹן (Tsiphyôwn) means Tsiphjon , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Gen 46 16.

definitions.full: H6837. Tsiphyon צִפְיוֺן proper name, masculine Σαφων : son of Gad(? gaze ); — Gen 46:16 , = צְפוֺן Num 26:15 (see צ ׳בַּעַל ).
